title: Gate CI on a data-classification marker check for every MCP tool schema
description: Add a vitest suite (src/tools/mongodb/__tests__/dataClassification.test.ts or equivalent) in the mongodb-mcp-server fork that enumerates every registered mongodb/* tool schema and asserts each carries a data-classification marker, failing with the offending tool name when one is missing, and wire it into the existing blocking unit-tests CI gate from sdlc/policy.json ciGates. Constraints: the suite must not require a database connection; merge via a reviewed PR with one approver; ship through the dev -> qa -> prod environments order; task dueAt no later than the initiative dueAt of 2026-09-29T23:48:58Z.
acceptanceCriteria: A vitest suite enumerates every registered mongodb/* tool schema and fails, naming the tool, when any schema lacks a data-classification marker
The suite runs inside the blocking unit-tests CI gate from sdlc/policy.json ciGates and passes on main
Removing one marker on a scratch branch makes the suite fail, demonstrating that the guard catches regressions before they reach the gateway

verificationMethod.description: Run pnpm vitest run src/tools/mongodb/__tests__/dataClassification.test.ts expecting all cases to pass; then on a scratch branch temporarily remove a marker from one schema and re-run expecting a failure that names the tool; restore the marker before merge

rootCause.description: No review, CI or probe step in the tool-schema process checked for classification markers, so the omission reached the gateway unchecked until the probe-schemas run
